source.notes: Mathias-Copeman's correlation, three fitted parameters from the `mc1..3` columns, with `c1` replaced by the base `m` when effectively zero.

derivation:
The driver was run for methane 0.6 / n-butane 0.4 at 330 K and 25 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(4)`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 0.8114305865146109
  k    [13.000518101563108, 0.2897411832553591]
  x    [0.05587847393668241, 0.9441215260633177]
  y    [0.7264491119015599, 0.2735508880984402]
  Zl   0.09244715555553443
  Zv   0.9107980234148848

azoth reproduces all six to the same residue the other cubic cases show.
